scripts.setup: node scripts/prepare-env.mjs && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client && npm run prisma:generate --prefix server && npm run prisma:migrate --prefix server && npm run seed --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
